## Read first: dev cycle (from memory)

Every new combat/UI system must follow the **three-source methodology** before code lands. Captured in memory `feedback-three-source-cross-reference`:

1. **Phase A — cross-reference doc** (no code). Quote relevant lines from ACE server (`~/ace-server/Source/`), RynthSuite/RynthCore plugin SDK (`/mnt/wbterminal1/ac-refs/{rynthsuite,rynthcore}/`), and `~/ac-headers/acclient.h` retail debug-info. Output: `docs/<system>-cross-reference-YYYY-MM-DD.md`.
2. **Phase B — wire the primitive** (tests, no UI). Add the GameAction packet to `crates/holtburger-protocol/`; add `SessionCommand` + `SessionHandle.<method>` wasm bindings + recv-loop arm; add facade method to `apps/holtburger-web/plugins/api.js`; protocol-level pack/unpack tests.
3. **Phase C — visible behavior** (in-game). Click→action wired in picking.js or the relevant plugin panel; subscribe to response events through `client.events.emit(...)`. **This is the step we have NOT actually validated against ACE for any system since Phase B.**
4. **Phase D+ — iterate.** Each subsequent primitive gets its own cross-reference + B + C cycle.

Also in scope per memory `feedback-no-partial-demos`: **don't bypass the load-bearing path**. If you can't fully demonstrate the wire round-trip against a live ACE bridge, say so — don't fake it with synthetic stubs and call it done.

## Validation gaps

**Live-ACE validation has not happened for any of Phases B–J.** All checks are offline browser smoke with synthetic SessionHandle stubs. The wire packets *could* be misaligned and we wouldn't know.

Specific items that need a live bridge to confirm:

1. **Every wire packet shipped** — `TargetedMeleeAttack 0x0008`, `TargetedMissileAttack 0x000A`, `CastTargetedSpell 0x004A`, `CastUntargetedSpell 0x0048`, `RemoveSpellFromBook 0x01A8`. Protocol pack/unpack tests pass but the round-trip with ACE has never fired.
2. **Charge Attack heading math** — `pose.heading` convention assumed `atan2`-compatible (radians, CCW from +X). If wrong, the player will run in a circle on first click. Single sign-flip fix in `scene3d/picking.js`.
3. **Power-meter refill duration** — H.6 approximates `600 + power × 1200 ms`. Real ACE refill timer is in the `AttackDone` / `CombatCommenceAttack` events; needs payload inspection.
4. **Stance change detection** — depends on ACE re-broadcasting `motionStance` after a `ChangeCombatMode` toggle. Verified via `applyConfirmedStance` reads in code but never live.
5. **`Entity.spell_book` population** — `playerKnownSpells()` reads cached snapshot refreshed on stats-update hook. Confirmed via synthetic stub; never confirmed that ACE actually populates the spell_book field on IdentifyObject response for the local player.

**Recommended first action for next session**: bring up `holtburger-wsbridge` + a local ACE (per `docs/ace-local-setup.md`), spawn a Holtburg test character, exercise: enter combat mode → click a Drudge → confirm melee attack lands → confirm damage event fires → press Delete on a known spell in spellbook → confirm ACE acks.

If anything misbehaves, fix is single-file and small.

## Remaining work (ranked by player impact)

The audit (`docs/ui-conformance-audit-2026-05-17.md`) listed everything. Below is what's still open, ordered by how much a real player would feel the gap.

### Tier 1 — gameplay-affecting

1. **Live-ACE validation pass** (above). Highest-leverage thing left. Without it, everything else is theoretical.
2. **Real MotionTable swing / draw / cast animations.** Phase C ships a vibe-pose (right arm rotates 300 ms triangle) for melee swings. Retail had per-weapon motion-table-driven anims. Removing the `classifyMotionCommand` filter that drops attack commands today is the load-bearing change. **Three-source doc required first** — find ACE's motion broadcast on swing, RynthSuite's anim-hook, retail's `MotionCommand::Attack` family.
3. **Radar / minimap.** Audit Phase I deferral. Retail's circular top-right radar with filter toggles (player / monster / item / corpse / NPC) is a defining AC UI element. Doable as a bar-plugin reading the entity map.
4. **Charge Attack — manual-input override.** Today the rAF loop fights WASD: charge keeps setting `forward=1, turn=±1` each frame while player WASD overrides per-frame. Document said "tug of war; fix in Phase J" — never fixed. Subscribe to a movement-input-changed event and abort charge on manual WASD.

### Tier 2 — visible but second-order

5. **Power-meter — real refill timer** instead of `600 + power × 1200 ms` approximation. Read from `attackDone` / `commenceAttack` event payload (if ACE carries it) or from a server snapshot.
6. **Full `SpellComponentTable` extraction** (163 entries). Current `data/spell-components.json` has only 8 scarabs. Needs either: (a) DatReaderWriter standalone build (codegen deps don't currently compile), or (b) a small Rust tool wrapping the wasm-side DAT reader to dump DID `0x0E00000F`. **(b) is the right path** — it lives in this repo, no external builds.
7. **Bigger spell catalog.** `data/spells-catalog.json` has 26 starter spells. Players reaching mid-game will have hundreds. Lazy-load full LSD catalogue (5.2 MB) with pagination in spellbook, or generate a server-side catalog endpoint.
8. **Components panel + `@fillcomps`** — retail's `Magic Panel` "Components" tab + the four `@fillcomps` chat-command variants. Requires vendor-UI plumbing first.
9. **Options Panel** plugin. Audit identified 4 tabs of options in retail (Gameplay / Character / Chat / Config). Today we only persist combat-related options to localStorage; server-side `CharacterOption` bitfield not round-tripped.
10. **Compass.** Same audit-Phase-I deferral as Radar. Smaller scope; reads `pose.heading`.

### Tier 3 — polish / cosmetic / nice-to-have

11. **Map panel** (audit Phase J+).
12. **Allegiance / Social Systems panels** (Phase K+).
13. **Re-examine wire opcode** — manual `IdentifyObject` request from J.3's Examine button + a small appraisal panel. Currently logs only.
14. **Inventory plugin** — absorb `#inventory-panel` + Selected Item Box into a bar-plugin slot for architectural consistency.
15. **Spell icons via DAT.** LSD has `iconID` (surface DID at 0x06xxxxxx). Wire `fetchSurfacesPixels` for spellbook + combat-bar slot icons.
16. **Multiple secondary chat windows.** Retail had 4 named chat-window tabs with per-window category subscriptions. We have one.
17. **Tab names / icons** for spell-bar tabs. Today they're "1"–"7"; retail allowed renaming.
18. **Stretch UI / Display 3D Tooltips / Show Coordinates by Radar** Options Panel toggles (audit catch-all).

### Tier 4 — Phase A (cross-reference) blockers

Some items need a three-source doc before we touch code. Tagged here so the next agent knows to write the doc first:

- **Trade** — `Trade.cs` in ACE. Existing protocol crate already has `OpenTradeNegotiations`, `AddToTrade`, etc. Wire is plumbed; UX missing.
- **Allegiance** — `SwearAllegiance` / `BreakAllegiance` in protocol already. Social systems UX missing.
- **Item Tinkering** — full system, never touched.
- **House ownership / Mansion teleport** — `TeleToMansion` already in protocol. UX missing.

## Recommended Phase K plan

Per the dev cycle from memory, the next coherent phase should be:

**Phase K — "Validate what we shipped, then polish."**

K.1 (Phase B+C re-validate): Bring up `holtburger-wsbridge` + local ACE per `docs/ace-local-setup.md`. Walk through:
- Login → spawn at Holtburg
- Enter combat mode (verify dove icon flips)
- Click a Drudge → confirm melee attack lands, damage feed populates, swing pose plays
- Hold ` to leave combat
- Enter magic mode (need wand/orb/staff equipped)
- Combat-bar panel transforms to spell picker
- Drag spell from F5 Spellbook to combat-bar slot 0
- Click an enemy → cast lands
- Press Delete on a spell in spellbook → confirm ACE broadcasts `MagicRemoveSpell`

Single capture script under `apps/holtburger-web/capture_phase_k_combat_validation.cjs`. Any wire mismatch surfaces here as a one-line fix.

K.2 (Tier 1 follow-on): Pick **one** of `Real MotionTable swing` / `Radar` / `Charge manual-override`. All three are Phase A-required (need a fresh cross-reference doc before code).

Subsequent phases (L, M, …) can pick from Tier 2/3 individually. The plugin architecture supports incremental drops; one plugin per phase is the natural cadence.

## Closing note

Phases A–J shipped a coherent combat + UI surface that **looks right** in browser-smoke offline tests but has **not been driven by a live ACE server**. The single highest-leverage next step is K.1 — validation. Everything else is downstream of confirming the wire packets actually work.

If K.1 surfaces a misalignment, the fix is small (single-file, often single-line). If K.1 passes clean, the combat layer is genuinely complete through targeted-cast + auto-pursue + numbered spell-bar tabs, and Phase K.2 can pick the next user-visible feature.

The plugin architecture (`mountBar({slots})` + `slot.activate(bodyEl, ctx)`) has proven robust: 4 real plugins shipped (stance-toggle, combat-bar, spellbook, settings-popover-via-gear) without any architectural pivots needed since Phase D refactored bar.js to accept slot arrays. Future plugins follow the same pattern.

— end of handoff
